_comment: Provenance capture hooks for Claude Code. Merge the `hooks` block into your project .claude/settings.json. Assumes provenance-kit is vendored at ./provenance-kit (its module_path); adjust the paths if you vendored it elsewhere. post_tool_use records each tool call; stop aggregates them into one hash-chained audit entry. Both no-op unless PROVENANCE_SESSION_DIR is set (i.e. the build was launched via a provenance-enabled launcher).
